chapter: Follow-up questions, Bird and the Ellington sidemen
title: Size of Nat Cole's and Fambro's bands
summary: Nat Cole's 1937 band had five saxophones and six brass against Fambro's eight pieces.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Uh-huh. When we were talking about Chicago and you were talking about Nat Cole's big band of 1937, how big was it?
Oh, like in -- let's see, I guess he had five saxophones and six brass.
Because you mentioned battle of the bands with Tony Fambreau and you said Fambreau's band wasn't that large, but I think you said it was, what, eight pieces.
So it was a really big band, a full big band against an eight piece band.
